metadata.title: Brutus-Pell Connected Spectrum: High-Precision Finite-Sample Study
metadata.description: High-precision numerical data and reproducibility code for a pair-normalized connected interaction spectrum in the Brutus-Pell prime corridor p=72t^2+1. The archive includes 70-digit evaluations at X=2M,4M,8M for Q=199,997, a float64 precision-wall audit, finite-sample convergence diagnostics, and the first five-role ASTRAEUM verification artifact.
metadata.notes: Finite-sample computational record. No asymptotic law, physical interpretation, or universal coefficient sign law is claimed.
